units.source_text: [\[28\]](#part1330.html#w28) 本书原文中人物大都无专名词，后人为便于阅读起见，根据各回题名或诗文内容给某些人物取名。

en.t: In the original text of this book, most characters do not have proper names; later readers, for ease of reading, gave names to certain characters based on the titles of the chapters or the contents of poems and prose.
Lady Aoi is one such example.
